Undergraduate online week

Join us for a series of online events for students who are considering studying for an undergraduate degree, designed to help you make informed decisions about your future.

•Book your session

News

First UK diabetes drug patient

University of Birmingham team played key role in NICE approval of Type 1 Diabetes-delaying drug Teplizumab which was used for first time in the UK in Birmingham.

•Read more about this story

Study here

Big city energy

As the UK’s second city, you can enjoy the food, sport and music you love without global-city prices. With more green space than Paris, there’s always plenty to explore.

•Explore Birmingham

Transforming disease detection

Our researchers are changing the way the world detects disease, enabling young people at risk of developing type 1 diabetes to access life-changing treatment before symptoms show.
